result:
PR #321 is marked ready. The device arm passed on the host with no regressions, but it only partly met the brief's size targets: large rows remain on the bitri rows and on `w_gaps`.

**Arm result** (both W_param hunks together, 587 captures): all 570 registered checks held. 19 captures got better, 0 got worse, 568 were unchanged, and exact matches went from 116 to 117.

| row | before | after | target |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| ff quad extremes (5 rows) | 79,174 | 314 | ~314, met |
| ff quad w0.00 / winf | 72,012 / 25,600 | 376 / 0 | ~0, met |
| ff bitri w-inf / winf | 114,508 / 12,880 | 511 / 240 | under 2,000, met |
| ff bitri w±0.00 plus the 6 extreme rows | 68k–146k | ~3,250 | under 2,000, **missed** |
| w_gaps, w_gaps_tex_persp | 145,687 | 31,743 | under 25,000, **missed** |

- **Must-not-move rows:** all unchanged, including the Lighting/Shade neighbours of the vsh-ff.c change.
- **Is the divide the cause?** Yes. The brief said the fix was refuted if the bitri extremes stayed near 146k; they fell to ~3.2k. The residuals on the 8 bitri rows and `w_gaps` need a different rule, which I haven't identified. They're written up for the next lane in `docs/lanes/wparamcode223/NOTES.md`.
- **Checks on the device runs:** neither run has an unreadable capture. The only partial suite is Front_face (24 of 36 scored), the same in both runs.

**Why no CI had run:** the PR conflicted with master, so GitHub built nothing. The only conflict was `docs/testing/nv2a_index.json`. I took master's copy and rebuilt it over the same test-repo commits CI checks against. It now differs from master only in four geom.c line numbers (+12) and its provenance.

**What I updated:**
- NOTES.md now records why attempts 1 and 2 stopped (both were waiting on the device run) and the verdict above.
- `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passes.
- The PR body's `Files:` line matches the diff, and I added the verdict to the body.
- I posted a `[lane.wparamcode223] ready:` comment.

CI hasn't run on the new head (`cdf844872e`) yet; the fold job waits for it to go green.
